description: This Java source file defines Cucumber hooks for managing WebDriver lifecycle during test scenarios. It handles setup before scenarios, including logging configuration and initializing WebDriver, and teardown after scenarios, including taking screenshots on failure and quitting WebDriver. It also contains logic to skip WebDriver initialization for database-only scenarios and logs configuration settings once per test run.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Contains Cucumber hook implementations for setting up and tearing down WebDriver scenarios with additional logging, configuration management, and screenshot support.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new WebDriver before each scenario, with special handling for database-only scenarios, and logs scenario and environment details.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Handles actions after each scenario, including capturing a screenshot if the scenario failed, and quitting the WebDriver.

methods.name: logConfigOnce
methods.description: Logs the configuration summary once per test run using a synchronized check.

methods.name: isDatabaseOnlyScenario
methods.description: Determines if a scenario is exclusively a database scenario based on its tags, to skip WebDriver initialization.

methods.name: captureScreenshot
methods.description: Captures and attaches a screenshot to the Cucumber report if WebDriver is available.
